class.name: VisionOSMarkerTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a reference image, such as a printed QR code, found by ARKit.
class.description: Represents an ARKit image anchor for an image registered with [method VisionOSXRInterface.add_marker_reference_image]. Trackers are named [code]visionos/marker/<uuid>[/code] and added to the [XRServer] when ARKit first finds the image. The [code]default[/code] pose follows the OpenXR spatial marker convention: the origin is the image center, +X points to the image's right, +Y towards its top edge, and +Z out of the printed face. While [member marker_tracked] is [code]false[/code] the last pose is kept with [constant XRPose.XR_TRACKING_CONFIDENCE_LOW].

method.name: get_marker_observation
method.description: Returns one coherent native observation, rather than combining metadata from different updates. The dictionary contains [code]name[/code] and [code]uuid[/code] ([String]), [code]transform[/code] ([Transform3D]), [code]tracked[/code] and [code]removed[/code] ([bool]), [code]physical_size[/code] ([Vector2]), [code]estimated_scale_factor[/code] ([float]), [code]reference_revision[/code], [code]generation[/code], [code]sequence[/code], and [code]received_ticks_usec[/code] ([int]), and [code]observation_time[/code] ([float]). The transform is in raw tracking meters, centered on the registered image: +X printed-right, +Y printed-top, +Z out of the face. No XR world scale or reference-frame adjustment is applied. Do not apply another ARKit-to-marker axis correction. Wall/floor alignment that preserves gravity should constrain the application alignment to yaw and translation, not alter this measured pose. [code]observation_time[/code] is the ARKit image anchor timestamp. [code]received_ticks_usec[/code] is captured when its native callback starts, using the same monotonic clock as [method Time.get_ticks_usec]. Receipt age is not sensor-capture age; do not directly subtract the ARKit timestamp from Godot ticks. [code]sequence[/code] advances only on a new accepted native update, never when polled. Out-of-order and duplicate tracked timestamps are rejected; same-timestamp loss/removal may invalidate an observation. Match [code]reference_revision[/code] and [code]generation[/code] against [method VisionOSXRInterface.get_image_tracking_status], require [code]tracked[/code], reject stale receipts, and use a distinct [code]sequence[/code] for each sample. Pausing, replacement, authorization loss, teardown and removal make [code]tracked[/code] false even if a caller retains this tracker. Retired trackers cannot acquire a later generation's observations.
